about: The one list of the website's screenshots. Drop <id>.webp, <id>.jpg or <id>.png beside this file and run `just website`: a present file is shown at its own size, a missing one is a labelled placeholder. See README.md beside this file.

shots.title: Bisa
shots.alt: The Bisa desktop application: the sidebar, a goal's run read downward, and the Inbox count
shots.capture: The whole window on the Inbox or a goal's page, the sidebar open.

shots.title: Goals
shots.alt: The Goals screen: each goal a card with its run strip, who it waits on and its verbs
shots.capture: The Goals list with a few goals in different states — running, waiting on you, done.

shots.title: Inbox
shots.alt: The Inbox: rows that wait on you — a gate to approve, a question with its options, a held step
shots.capture: The Inbox on Needs you, one gate and one question visible, the detail pane open on the question.

shots.title: Agents
shots.alt: The Agents screen: the three core agents and the catalog agents installed, each with its harness and model
shots.capture: Agents, with the General Agent, the Workflow Agent and the Decision-Making Agent at the top and a few catalog agents below.

shots.title: Teams
shots.alt: The Teams screen: a team with its members and its purpose
shots.capture: Teams, one team open with its members.

shots.title: The Project IDE
shots.alt: The Project IDE: projects and workstreams down the side, a harness at work in a terminal tab, and the workstream's road from commit to merge beside it
shots.capture: A project open in the IDE: the rail of projects and workstreams, a harness in a terminal tab, the workstream panel.

shots.title: Files and editor
shots.alt: The editor on a file of the checkout, the tree of its files beside it
shots.capture: A source file open in the editor with the Files pane beside it.

shots.title: Agents in the IDE
shots.alt: A conversation about a checkout: several agents answering one message, the checkout's files beside them
shots.capture: A conversation about a checkout in Agent mode, agents answering, the Files pane beside it.

shots.title: Embedded browser
shots.alt: The embedded browser beside the code, showing a folder of the checkout served on this machine
shots.capture: A served folder of the checkout open in the embedded browser, the Files pane beside it.

shots.title: Annotate for agents
shots.alt: Pointing at an element of a served page and saying what should change; the note becomes a chip for the agent
shots.capture: The browser's annotation: an element picked on the page, its note typed, the bar to send it to an agent.

shots.title: Git history
shots.alt: The commit history of a checkout beside a harness at work in a terminal tab
shots.capture: Git › History open beside a harness's terminal tab.

shots.title: Workflows
shots.alt: The Workflows library: each workflow a card with its graph and its runs
shots.capture: The Workflows library, Yours tab, a few cards.

shots.title: Workflow designer
shots.alt: The workflow designer on the Bug fix workflow: the palette of steps on the left, the graph on the canvas, the workflow's properties and its problems on the right
shots.capture: The designer on the catalog's Bug fix workflow: the palette, the whole graph, and the Properties pane with No problems.

shots.title: The Workflow Agent in the designer
shots.alt: The workflow designer with the Workflow Agent in its Agent pane: asked in plain words for a workflow, it built and saved it, and the canvas shows its steps
shots.capture: The designer with the Agent pane open, the Workflow Agent having just built a workflow it was asked for in plain words.

shots.title: Connectors
shots.alt: Settings › Connectors: the accounts of the platforms a workflow calls
shots.capture: Settings › Capabilities › Connectors with an account or two.

shots.title: A goal's workflow
shots.alt: A goal's Workflow tab: the proposed workflow on the canvas, the run's states on each step
shots.capture: The same goal's Workflow tab, its run's states on the steps.

shots.title: Pulse
shots.alt: The Pulse: the workspace's live feed of steps, messages and agents at work
shots.capture: The Pulse on All, a few minutes of a busy workspace.

shots.title: Channels
shots.alt: A channel: people and agents talking, an agent's reply streaming with its thinking folded
shots.capture: A channel with a few messages and an agent's reply.

shots.title: Direct messages
shots.alt: Direct messages: a direct channel with an agent
shots.capture: Direct messages, one open with an agent.

shots.title: Notes
shots.alt: Notes: a markdown note beside its conversation with an agent
shots.capture: The Notes panel on a note, split view, Ask an agent open.

shots.title: Drawing
shots.alt: A drawing on the canvas, an agent's shapes landing while the person watches
shots.capture: The Draw panel on a system-architecture drawing.

shots.title: Collaboration and people
shots.alt: Settings › People: people invited by link at a role, the relays and their health
shots.capture: Settings › Workspace › People with an invitation and a member; Relays & sync beside it.

shots.title: Security
shots.alt: Settings › Security: the Redactor, the Tool & Commands Guard's rules and the Classifier
shots.capture: Settings › Security › Guard with its rules, Try it filled.

shots.title: Decision-making
shots.alt: Settings › Decision Settings › Decision Making: who answers, the decision points, a question tried
shots.capture: Settings › Decision Settings › Decision Making with Try it answered.

shots.title: Addons
shots.alt: Addons floating over the app: a clock, the machine's load, the weather
shots.capture: Three or four addons open over a screen.

shots.title: Pets
shots.alt: Settings › Pet: the nine pets that ship with the app, one chosen, and the pet itself in the corner
